title: Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) Portal Status Notice
text: The Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) exercise has ended. Thank you for your participation. Please expect an email notification once administrative processes are completed, and follow the INEC Website for official updates.

title: Voter Education and Guidelines Official Portal Announcement
text: Voter Education & Guidelines Know your rights, understand the voting process, learn election day guidelines, and access official documents.
